title: Move shared/ui's 27 inline English strings into lib/words
body:
## Summary
Seven shared/ui primitives still carry their own English (labels, defaults, aria names) instead of taking it from lib/words, and three of them duplicate a words.ts constant.

## Description
AGENTS.md and docs/ux/UX-GUIDE.md make lib/words.ts the one vocabulary; console.tsx's header already states 'every user-facing string arrives as a prop (the caller takes it from lib/words.ts)'. The older primitives do not: apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/Sheet.tsx:42 ('Close', 'Close (Esc)'), apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/Inspector.tsx:49,53 ('Details', 'Close details', 'Close (Esc)'), apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/ThemeSwitch.tsx:8-15 ('Dark', 'Light', 'The Dial palette', 'PayPal palette', 'Theme'), apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/components.tsx:18,77,204,227-228,235 ('Breadcrumb', 'Nothing here.', ': not available yet', 'If you do nothing: ' x2, 'Reading {what}…'), apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/story.tsx:82,120,123,135,148,149 ('Details', CHECK_WORD x4, 'Checks', 'Show all', 'Hide passed', 'Show', 'not checked here'), apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/why.tsx:16 ('Why?'). Pairs that must agree: Silence's 'If you do nothing' vs words.ts IF_NOTHING; Inspector's 'Details' vs lib/words/framework.ts INSPECTOR_LABEL; Crumbs' 'Breadcrumb' vs CRUMBS_LABEL 'Where you are'. Fixed: each literal is a named key in lib/words/framework.ts (or a new lib/words/ui.ts re-exported once), primitives import it, and a guard test keeps new literals out.

## Flow
- Write shared/ui/words.test.ts: read each non-test shared/ui/*.tsx, strip comments, count JSX text and string-literal values of label/title/aria-label/detailsLabel defaults; seed red at 27
- Add the keys (reusing IF_NOTHING, INSPECTOR_LABEL, CRUMBS_LABEL where the words match the intent) and import them in the seven files
- Re-run: guard 0, existing shared/ui and window suites green (tests that query by these names keep the same text)

## Expected impact
Copy owners change a primitive's words in one place and the area words guards can cover shared/ui; nothing visible changes. Could break: a window test querying 'Close' by role name if a key's text drifts.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one vocabulary for every on-screen string
Before: 27 inline literals in 7 shared/ui files, 3 duplicating words.ts keys (grep, this round)
After: 0 inline literals; guard test red on a seeded literal
Method: simulation - the 27 sites were counted by grep; the change spans 7 files plus a shared words file, over S for this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: new apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/words.test.ts counting inline literals in shared/ui/*.tsx (27 -> 0), seeded red

title: Five words.ts keys only the docs still name: restore the surface or drop both
body:
## Summary
BEAD_UNKNOWN_LEGEND, START_UNDERWAY, RESCUE_COUNTED, RESCUE_SENT_NOT_COUNTED and CHARTER_OPEN have no reader in code, yet live docs say a screen shows them.

## Description
A zero-consumer grep this round (grep -rlw over apps/desktop/client/src and git grep over the repo) found no code reader for these five exports of apps/desktop/client/src/lib/words.ts; the 21 that no doc named were deleted (f750c13). These five are still claimed: docs/ux/UX-GUIDE.md:112 ('its legend reads "not known yet" (BEAD_UNKNOWN_LEGEND)'; the Dial legend went with ad8a8c3), docs/build/DECISIONS.md:1089 (same), docs/ux/UX-GUIDE.md:115 (first-run 'Under way' section, START_UNDERWAY), docs/features/rescue.md:30-31 (recovered money 'each line marked Counts / Doesn't count with the reason (RESCUE_COUNTED, RESCUE_REPLAY_NOT_COUNTED, RESCUE_SENT_NOT_COUNTED)' - only the replay one is read), docs/build/rebuild/wp3c.md:111 (Settings > Also here: CHARTER_OPEN). Either the rebuild dropped a behaviour the docs still promise (restore it) or the docs are stale (delete key and doc line together).

## Flow
- For each key, render the surface its doc names (Rewind legend, first-run Under way, Rescue recovered list, Settings 'Also here') and assert the text
- Text absent and surface intentionally gone: delete the key and the doc sentence in one commit
- Text absent but the promise still stands (Rescue's per-line reasons is the likely one): restore the line and keep the key

## Expected impact
The UX guide stops describing words nobody sees, or the Rescue page regains its reason per line. Could break nothing in code; a doc reader loses a stale claim.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - docs and vocabulary describe the same screens
Before: 5 exports with 0 code readers, 6 doc lines claiming them on screen
After: 0 unclaimed exports; each doc line backed by a render test or removed
Method: probe - the consumer counts are measured; which side is right is a product reading of each surface
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
grep -rlw BEAD_UNKNOWN_LEGEND apps/desktop/client/src -> words.ts only
git grep -lw RESCUE_COUNTED -> docs/features/rescue.md only
docs/ux/UX-GUIDE.md:115 | first-run deals started by the path | **Under way** ... | `START_UNDERWAY`.
instrument: per-key render test of the doc-named surface (5 keys); zero-consumer grep after

title: Drop ui.css rules for the explainer, stepper, sidebar and title bar nothing renders
body:
## Summary
ui.css still styles .ui-explainer, .ui-stepper, .ui-sidebar/.ui-sb-* and .ui-titlebar, whose components were deleted (6105919) and whose classes no file in src or the window html uses.

## Description
After the dead shared/ui exports went, a class grep over apps/desktop/client/src and the four window html files finds these class names only in apps/desktop/client/src/design/ui.css: the explainer block (ui.css ~300-313), the stepper block (~376-389), the sidebar block (ui.css:43-54, the has-insp sidebar lines in the 1180px media query at 37-40, and .ui-sb-item in the forced-colors block), and .ui-titlebar/.ui-title/.ui-titlebar .kbd (21-23, ~243). .ui-stat is NOT dead (windows/tumbler/forms.tsx uses the class). The rules are interleaved with live ones (.ui-split media query, forced-colors), so the removal needs a visual check, not only a grep.

## Flow
- Remove the dead selectors only, leaving .ui-split and .ui-stat rules intact
- Count ui.css rules before/after; run the director's three-window screenshot pass in both themes and compare

## Expected impact
~45 fewer CSS lines in the one stylesheet every window loads; no visual change. Could break: a selector list that mixes a dead and a live class if split carelessly.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - ui.css styles only what renders
Before: 4 dead class families, ~45 lines (grep this round)
After: 0 dead families; screenshots unchanged in dark and light
Method: simulation - class consumers counted; no visual gate is reachable in a round agent (no dev server)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: class-consumer grep (4 families -> 0) plus director screenshot diff of main, approval, tumbler in both themes

title: director.css says 'Tokens only' but writes 20 colours by value
body:
## Summary
The scenario director's stylesheet claims tokens only and holds 20 raw colour literals, so its stage does not follow the light theme it says it inherits.

## Description
apps/desktop/client/src/director/director.css:1-3 says 'Tokens only (src/design/tokens.css); the light theme comes from <html data-theme="light">', but lines 7, 10, 11, 14, 17 and others carry #07090c, #0b0e12, #dfe5ee and rgba(...) values (20 matches after comments are stripped). The new tokens.test colour guard (8dbc61a) excludes src/director/ because the director is a sibling area in flux this wave. Fixed: the stage reads tokens (or tokens.css gains named stage roles) and the exclusion goes.

## Flow
- Map each literal to an existing token or a new named role in tokens.css (both themes)
- Remove 'src/director/' from the tokens.test exclusion; guard 20 -> 0

## Expected impact
The director stage follows the theme like the windows on it. Could break: the stage's look in light mode (it was dark-only by accident).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one colour authority
Before: 20 literals in director.css (tokens.test scan)
After: 0, guard covers src/director
Method: probe - counted by the guard's own regex this round; out of this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: tokens.test 'tokens.css holds the only colour literals' with src/director/ no longer excluded (20 -> 0)

title: Tumbler preview stage's drop-shadow writes rgba() despite 'Tokens only'
body:
## Summary
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/tumbler/preview/preview.css:74 draws its framed Tumbler shadow with two rgba(0, 0, 0, ...) values; its header says 'Tokens only (dark set)'.

## Description
The colour guard (8dbc61a) carries this file as KNOWN = 2 so the count may only shrink. --shadow-ink with color-mix (as tokens.css's --shadow-2/3 do) expresses the same shadow and follows the theme.

## Flow
- Replace both rgba() with color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow-ink) 40%/30%, transparent)
- Drop the KNOWN entry in tokens.test (2 -> 0)

## Expected impact
One less theme leak on the director's framed Tumbler. Could break nothing functional.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one colour authority
Before: 2 literals (guard KNOWN)
After: 0, KNOWN map empty
Method: probe - counted by the guard; file outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Row with onOpen is a role=button that invites buttons inside it
body:
## Summary
The Row primitive becomes a div role=button when onOpen is set, and its own docs tell callers to put chips and buttons inside it; ARIA buttons have presentational children, so those inner controls can vanish for screen readers.

## Description
apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/components.tsx Row: `role={act ? 'button' : undefined}` with `children` documented as 'Right-hand content: chips, amount, buttons' and an INTERACTIVE guard so inner clicks do not open the row. Under accessibility / primitive-level-a11y, a primitive must not compose into an inaccessible screen: role=button with focusable descendants is axe 'nested-interactive'. Live actionable consumer today: windows/approval/OwnerConfig.tsx:369 (rule rows). Fixed: an actionable Row renders its open affordance as a real button (the title) and keeps the row a plain container, or refuses interactive children when onOpen is set.

## Flow
- Write a test: Row with onOpen and a Chip onClick child; run axe-core's nested-interactive rule (or assert no focusable descendant inside role=button)
- Change Row so the open action is a button around the title cell; keep Enter/Space and click-on-row behaviour
- Re-run OwnerConfig and ListEngine suites

## Expected impact
Screen-reader users reach both the row's open action and any control inside it. Could break: row click targets and keyboard focus order in OwnerConfig.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every control inside a row is reachable by assistive tech
Before: 1 primitive documents nested buttons in a role=button; 1 live actionable consumer
After: 0 role=button containers with focusable descendants (axe nested-interactive 0)
Method: simulation - the primitive's own contract read; no axe run in this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
apps/desktop/client/src/shared/ui/components.tsx RowProps: /** Right-hand content: chips, amount (<span className="amt">), buttons. */
... role={act ? 'button' : undefined} tabIndex={act ? 0 : undefined}
instrument: axe nested-interactive (or a focusable-descendant assertion) over a Row with onOpen and a button child

title: Fill colours used as small text (deal.css --teal, tables.css --market)
body:
## Summary
tokens.css says 'never use a fill colour for small text'; windows/main/console/areas/deal.css:229 paints .dv-fresh in var(--teal) and tables.css:57 small labels in var(--market).

## Description
Rule breach checked against the reason for the rule (readability): --teal as text measures 4.57-5.56:1 by day and 6.85-9.00:1 by night on bg/panel/panel3/sheet; --market 8.17-13.38:1. Every pair clears 4.5:1, so swapping to --teal-l would change no readable figure.

## Flow
- Computed with lib/contrast's formula over tokens.css hex values, both themes

## Expected impact
None measurable.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - small text readable
Before: min 4.57:1 (--teal on --panel3, light)
After: --teal-l: also >= 4.5 (pinned by contrast.test)
Method: probe - contrast computed for both inks on 4 surfaces x 2 themes
Result: not-better
Gate: none
evidence: light teal bg:4.89 panel:5.45 panel3:4.57 sheet:5.56; dark teal bg:9.00 panel:8.30 panel3:6.85 sheet:8.23
